dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Hermes is derived by combining eirein with emesato, so the observation records the compound-building operation itself.

dispositions.label: etymology_uses_letter_substitution
dispositions.reason: The proposed Apollo derivation explicitly depends on substituting alpha for the initial sound of homo; that letter-level maneuver is the textual function.

dispositions.label: eudaimonia_as_unresolved_criterion
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The passage flags happiness as a criterion the current account has not yet met, marking unresolved adequacy rather than testing a definition by a concrete case.

dispositions.label: eudaimonia_criterion_stated
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Both observations state conditions under which possession or political order yields happiness; they formulate a criterion to be satisfied rather than propose the definiendum itself.

dispositions.label: evaluative_reclassification_of_definiendum
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Thrasymachus relocates injustice under virtue and wisdom while assigning justice to their opposites; the move reclassifies an already contested definiendum.

dispositions.label: evaluative_term_revaluation
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Across the records, inherited praise or blame terms are reassigned under a new evaluative standard; this repeatable revaluation differs from merely offering a definition.

dispositions.label: evaluative_terms_collected_by_domain
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The passage gathers uses of sharpness and speed across body, soul, voice, music, and painting to establish cross-domain evaluative usage.

dispositions.label: explicit_definition_marker
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The narrator explicitly marks a preceding formulation as a clear definition of temperance; the record tracks the speech-act marker, not only the proposed content.

dispositions.label: explicit_naming_convention_in_division
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Both records explicitly assign one convenient name to products grouped at a division step, preserving the naming convention used to continue diairesis.

dispositions.label: false_dichotomy_by_asymmetric_partition
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Each passage exposes a partition that sets one named unit against an undifferentiated multitude, diagnosing asymmetric division rather than testing a definition by case.

dispositions.label: false_judgment_named_as_outcome
dispositions.reason: The records name false judging as the outcome of a mismatch and state the aviary rule that produces it; their function is outcome classification.

dispositions.label: for_the_sake_of_regress_stopped_by_first_principle
dispositions.reason: The argument halts an instrumental friend-for-the-sake-of chain at a first friend, a regress-terminating role distinct from a definitional proposal.

dispositions.label: forced_assumption_of_definiendum
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Lysias compels the speech to assume eros at the outset instead of establishing it, recording a forced argumentative starting point.

dispositions.label: formal_classification_distinction
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The accepted records draw formal class contrasts such as virtue versus a virtue, necessary versus unnecessary desire, or paired hunting kinds; this is taxonomy construction, not definition proposal.

dispositions.label: fourfold_division_of_practice
dispositions.reason: The accepted record organizes flattery into a four-part practice taxonomy; the second record is rejected as a duplicate and mislabel, creating split pressure rather than support for a merge.

dispositions.label: friendship_as_acquisition
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The repeated ktaomai vocabulary casts a friend as something possessed or acquired, but the record explicitly leaves this metaphorical framing unexamined rather than offering a definition.

dispositions.label: genus_differentia_by_etymology
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The anthropos account obtains a genus and distinguishing trait through etymological decomposition; that hybrid analytic method is more specific than the status of a definition being proposed.

dispositions.label: genus_difficulty_hedge
dispositions.reason: The accepted record warns in advance that distinguishing the philosopher's genus will be difficult; the other record is rejected as a hunter-classification mislabel, so the surviving function is an inquiry-opening hedge.

dispositions.label: genus_membership_enumerated
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates collects equality, the double, and numerical or measured relations into the genus of limit; the repeatable operation is enumerating genus members.

dispositions.label: genus_versus_part_distinction
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger raises the unresolved methodological problem of telling a genuine genus from a merely named part, rather than proposing either as a definition.

dispositions.label: goods_catalogue_compiled
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Both records compile successive conventional goods into a catalogue; one adds wisdom and good fortune while the other cites a health-beauty-wealth ranking only to overturn it.

dispositions.label: gratification_criterion_reframed
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Lysian speech replaces neediness with return, worthiness, discretion, and durable friendship as recipient criteria; this is criterion revision within an exhortation.

dispositions.label: greatest_kinds_narrowed_from_forms
dispositions.reason: The Stranger narrows an inquiry over all forms to selected greatest kinds and names being, rest, and motion; its function is scope reduction before analysis.

dispositions.label: happiness_antithesis_pair
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates states a two-sided evaluative antithesis pairing noble-good people with happiness and unjust-wicked people with wretchedness; no definition is proposed or case-tested.

dispositions.label: happiness_as_disputed_criterion
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Polus reframes the disagreement over tyrant and victim around who is happier, making happiness the contested standard without defining that standard.

dispositions.label: harmless_pleasure_defined_as_play
dispositions.reason: The Stranger directly proposes that harmless pleasure is play whenever it neither harms nor benefits anything serious, the same definitional-proposal function as the licensed target.

dispositions.label: hypothesis_condition_stated
dispositions.reason: Across the ten records, an inquiry or consequence is made conditional on a supposition, candidate life, developmental condition, or if-then premise; hypothesis framing is distinct from definition proposal or concrete-case testing.

dispositions.label: hypothesis_formalized_as_supposition
dispositions.reason: Parmenides opens the exercise with the formal supposition 'if one is' and derives its first consequence, preserving an explicit hypothesis-and-deduction function.

dispositions.label: identity_persistence_through_flux
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The paired records develop persistence through replacement first for bodily and psychic constituents and then for knowledge through renewed memory; they articulate an identity-through-flux account.

dispositions.label: implicit_definition_exposed_via_consequences
dispositions.reason: Shared textual function: Socrates applies the implicit equation of good with self-preservation to the mechanic and exposes its unacceptable result, performing the licensed target's concrete-case test while the local consequence remains in the observation.

dispositions.label: inquiry_highest_principle_first
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger orders the investigation by taking being, identified as the greatest ruling principle, first; this is a programmatic inquiry sequence.

dispositions.label: inquiry_target_identified
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Theaetetus identifies what-is-not as the object they have been seeking because of the sophist; the move names the inquiry target without resolving it.

dispositions.label: inquiry_target_refined
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates corrects the sought craft from the greatest and most useful to the one examining what is clearest, most precise, and truest; this refines the question's criterion.

dispositions.label: instrumental_friendship_chain_terminus
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The argument terminates the chain of friends sought for another's sake in a first friend not instrumentally sought, preserving a regress-stopping structure.

dispositions.label: interbreeding_criterion
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger uses capacity for cross-generation to divide horses and donkeys from an unmixed tame herd; the record captures a specific diairetic criterion.

dispositions.label: interlocutor_concedes_absurdity
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Protarchus spontaneously concedes that treating pleasure as the good produces great absurdity; the record marks an interlocutor's unforced dialectical concession, not a case test.

dispositions.label: intermediate_become_friend_via_evil_presence
dispositions.reason: Socrates proposes the three-term formula that the neutral becomes friend to the good through a bad's presence; this is a new definitional stage with the same function as the licensed proposal target.

dispositions.label: intermediate_derived_from_opposites
dispositions.reason: The deduction infers equality as the middle between greatness and smallness after deriving both opposites from inequality; its function is logical midpoint derivation.

dispositions.label: intermediate_subject_position
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The passage locates the loving subject between good and bad and explains its orientation through the bad; it assigns a subject position within a tripartite scheme.

dispositions.label: intermediate_term_defined
dispositions.reason: The eight observations repeatedly construct a middle category between opposed poles, from pleasure-pain and motion-rest to opinion, Eros, and philosophers; this structural mediation is sharper than generic proposal status.

dispositions.label: internal_dialogue_as_doxa_formation
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates models doxa as the assertion produced by an internal question-and-answer exchange about an appearance, preserving a mechanism of judgment formation.

dispositions.label: key_term_identity_secured_by_assent
dispositions.reason: Socrates posits the identity of good and beautiful, obtains Menexenus's assent, and then uses it as a premise; the textual function is premise stabilization.

dispositions.label: kind_named_by_differentia
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger coins the acknowledged placeholder 'self-orderers' from a differentiating command relation to name a nearly nameless class, a specific taxonomic naming operation.

dispositions.label: known_different_known_formula
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Parmenides treats the phrase 'one is not' as saying something knowable and different from other things; the formula establishes semantic determinacy under negation.

dispositions.label: law_obedience_as_second_best
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The five records develop written-law obedience as a second-best imitation when knowledgeable rule is absent, including its rule, rationale, corruption case, and institutional cause.

dispositions.label: literal_wording_distinguished_from_intended_meaning
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Before testing 'doing one's own,' Socrates separates the uttered words from what their speaker meant; this is an interpretive distinction governing the ensuing test.

dispositions.label: logos_generated_from_doxa
dispositions.reason: Socrates directly proposes that logos arises when an internally held doxa is voiced to another person, performing the licensed target's definitional-proposal function.

dispositions.label: mathematical_collection_unified_under_one
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The boys respond to infinitely many square-root cases by undertaking to collect them into one class; the record captures the collection project before its resulting definition.

dispositions.label: means_end_hierarchy_formulated
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates states the teleological hierarchy that each becoming is for a being and all becoming for all being; it is a means-end principle rather than a definition.

dispositions.label: mixture_criterion_shifting
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The admission rule for the good-life mixture shifts sequentially from true pleasures to necessary pleasures, so the record tracks changing inclusion criteria.

dispositions.label: mixture_proportion_classification
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates classifies pleasure-pain mixtures by equal versus unequal shares and by which side tips the balance, a proportional taxonomy of mixed states.

dispositions.label: most_honored_and_causal_element_inquiry
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The passage opens a ranking inquiry into which mixture component is most honored and most causal without yet supplying the answer.

dispositions.label: multiple_names_single_knowledge
dispositions.reason: The Stranger treats kingly, political, and household-management names as indifferent alternatives for one knowledge; its repeatable function is terminological unification across names.

dispositions.label: name_etymology_from_earlier_form
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The current name for the shameful is derived from a longer earlier compound meaning continual obstruction of flow, preserving a historical-form etymology.

dispositions.label: name_etymology_via_concealment
dispositions.reason: The moon-name is explained as a compressed ordinary form that conceals a fuller descriptive compound, a distinct phonetic-concealment etymology.

dispositions.label: name_function_defined
dispositions.reason: All three records propose what names characteristically do—teach, distinguish, reveal, or signify things—so they perform the licensed target's definitional-proposal function while retaining each formulation locally.

dispositions.label: name_power_defined_as_teaching_things
dispositions.reason: Cratylus directly answers that names have the power and benefit of teaching things, a proposed definition matching the licensed target.

dispositions.label: name_reality_contrast
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The three records use plurality, identity, or divergence of names and things to pressure a monist thesis or frame a procedural choice; they stage a name-reality dilemma rather than propose a definition.

dispositions.label: names_as_teaching_method_under_review
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates reformulates Cratylus's likeness-based teaching claim and asks whether names are the best or only route to beings; the method is under review, not newly defined.

dispositions.label: naming_via_division_terminus
dispositions.reason: Each record assigns a final name only after tracing a diairetic branch to its terminus—sophist or weaving—so the repeatable function is endpoint naming through division.

dispositions.label: nature_habit_criterion
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Athenian classifies musical response by agreement or conflict between nature, acquired habit, and represented character, including a mixed case where the factors diverge.

dispositions.label: near_synonym_distinction
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The three records separate closely neighboring terms—possession from active having, standing from praise, and intellectual gladness from bodily pleasure—through explicit contrasts.

dispositions.label: necessity_condition_for_ruler
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates gives a disjunction of necessary historical conditions for philosophical rule—compulsion of philosophers or conversion of power-holders—without defining the ruler.

dispositions.label: nested_consequence_chain
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger makes agreement about being and non-being a precondition for coherent talk of false speech, opinion, images, and imitative arts, creating a nested dependency chain.

dispositions.label: nested_diairetic_chain
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: A seven-level division runs from discriminative art through soul-purification and teaching to elenchus as noble sophistry; the nested chain is the recorded textual operation.

dispositions.label: new_definition_proposed_after_aporia
dispositions.reason: Immediately after aporia, Socrates proposes pleasure through sight and hearing as a fresh candidate for the beautiful; its core function is the licensed target's definition proposal.

dispositions.label: not_by_nature
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Both records deny natural acquisition of political virtue and contrast it with teaching or care; one announces the thesis and one infers it from a counterfactual social practice.

dispositions.label: numbered_kinds_in_series
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates explicitly numbers body-based pleasure and pain as one kind and soul-only anticipation as a second, recording ordered kind introduction rather than a definition.

dispositions.label: one_over_many_form_reasoning
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: One record asks for the single common feature behind many desires, while the other warns that one homonymous craft-name can falsely impose unity; both stage a one-many problem without resolving it.

dispositions.label: ordered_ascent_steps
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The two records lay out explicitly marked stages from bodies through practices and sciences to Beauty itself, preserving the ordered ladder as the repeatable structure.

dispositions.label: ordered_birth_rank_catalogue
dispositions.reason: The passage enumerates nine birth-types in descending order according to prior vision of truth; its function is an ordinal life-rank catalogue.

dispositions.label: ordered_goods_hierarchy
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Athenian divides goods into ranked divine and dependent human classes and orders the members of each, forming an explicit goods hierarchy.

dispositions.label: paired_terms_submitted_for_analysis
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Hermogenes submits soul and body as the next paired names for etymological treatment; this is a procedural setup before either account is given.

dispositions.label: perceptual_illustration_introduced
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates introduces the distant, indistinct figure beside a rock to illustrate how perceptual judgment forms, preserving the example-setup role.

dispositions.label: philosophy_demarcated_by_measure_and_age
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Callicles values philosophy only when practiced moderately at the proper age and condemns its excess, drawing an evaluative boundary by measure and life stage.

dispositions.label: philosophy_demarcated_from_education
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Callicles permits philosophy only as youthful education and condemns its continuation in older age; the passage demarcates legitimate scope rather than defining philosophy.

dispositions.label: phonetic_transformation_in_name_formation
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates explains removal, insertion, and accent shift as operations that turn a verb into a name and applies them to anthropos; this is a phonetic formation method.

dispositions.label: pleasure_hierarchy_by_remoteness
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates ranks philosophical, oligarchic-democratic, and tyrannical pleasures by numbered distance from logos and truth, constructing a remoteness hierarchy.

dispositions.label: pleasure_kind_defined_by_absence_of_pain_mix
dispositions.reason: The first record classifies smell pleasures by absence of necessary pain, while the second tests learning pleasures for antecedent or loss-pain; this definition-versus-criterion split prevents a single licensed merge.

dispositions.label: poetic_authority_contradiction
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates juxtaposes contradictory Theognidean claims about learning virtue to show that poets and other alleged authorities offer no consistent answer.

dispositions.label: political_domain_scale_collapsed
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger equates household manager with master and treats a large household and small city as identical with respect to rule; the move collapses domain scale.

dispositions.label: political_name_conditioned_on_implanting_bond
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Ability to implant the specified bond in properly educated souls becomes a condition for receiving the politician or good-lawgiver title; this is a naming-eligibility test.

dispositions.label: political_virtue_distributed_to_all
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The sole cited record is rejected because its empty term list and broad topic framing duplicate accepted neighboring procedure records; no accepted observation licenses either merge target.

dispositions.label: popular_vs_expert_naming_divergence
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger contrasts popular naming of wickedness and ignorance with the argument's classification of both as kinds of psychic badness, preserving a naming divergence.

dispositions.label: precision_criterion_announced_before_division
dispositions.reason: Before dividing the sciences, Socrates announces exactness concerning clarity and purity as the comparison criterion; this is prospective methodological framing.

dispositions.label: predecessor_claim_contradicted
dispositions.reason: The records explicitly oppose or correct named predecessors' claims—Parmenides on not-being, Heraclitus on harmony, and an earlier claim about Eros's age—so contradiction of inherited authority is the common function.

dispositions.label: preliminaries_distinguished_from_art
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates separates mastery of necessary harmonic preliminaries from comprehension of harmonics itself, a competence-level distinction rather than a definition of the art.

dispositions.label: premature_label_acknowledged_retrospectively
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger retrospectively identifies 'royal and political' as a premature name for the two-footed herd-rearing branch and reopens refinement.

dispositions.label: previous_thesis_set_aside_not_refuted
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates dismisses two earlier friendship theses to redirect the inquiry without declaring either false, marking suspension rather than refutation.

dispositions.label: primary_names_hypothesis
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates resumes the hypothesis that primary names are composed from elementary sounds resembling things, distinguishing them by compositional level.

dispositions.label: principle_stated_as_antithetical_pair
dispositions.reason: Both records introduce a principle through balanced opposites—motion versus rest as causes, and the One as moving and resting—so antithetical formulation is the repeatable function.

dispositions.label: psychic_part_mapping
dispositions.reason: Five Republic records map soul parts to names, desires, persons, and pleasures, while the Phaedrus record only stages chariot conflict and disclaims that mapping; this structural cluster has internal split pressure but matches neither licensed target.

dispositions.label: psychological_progression_tracked
dispositions.reason: One record traces fear through cessation and habituated fearlessness, while the other sequences inquiry from ignorance to envy; both track stages, but their distinct progressions provide no definition-proposal or case-test merge.

dispositions.label: purity_criterion_announced
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates announces anticipatory pleasure and pain as the domain where pure, unmixed states will become visible; the criterion is prospective rather than applied here.

dispositions.label: qualities_predicated_of_pleasure_and_pain
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates secures agreement that pleasure and pain can acquire predicates such as badness and correctness beyond merely being what they are; the move establishes predicability.

dispositions.label: ranked_criterion_sequence
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The accepted record identifies lot-rule as the seventh title to rule, while the other is rejected as a partial duplicate of a fuller hierarchy; the evidence supports sequence position, not either merge target.

dispositions.label: ranked_goods_hierarchy
dispositions.reason: The three records explicitly order goods by numbered rank—from Philebus's five positions to Laws hierarchies of soul, body, property, and ruling possessions—so ranked hierarchy is the common function.

dispositions.label: recapitulation_or_restart
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Each record pauses to restate an agreed framework, numbered kinds, candidate lives, or prior classification before restarting or advancing the inquiry; this is procedural recapitulation.

dispositions.label: reciprocal_erotic_response_named
dispositions.reason: The passage proposes anteros, an image of eros, as the name and account of the beloved's reciprocal state; this signed anchor performs the licensed target's definitional-proposal function.

dispositions.label: recollection_condition_specified
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates adds the metacognitive requirement that recollection from a similar object notice whether it falls short of the recollected object; the move specifies a condition within an argument.

dispositions.label: relative_measure_articulated
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger articulates the reciprocal greater-than-lesser relation as the first measurement branch before contrasting it with due measure.

dispositions.label: remedy_introduced_as_dual_structure
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The remedy is introduced as an interdependent physical leaf and spoken charm, with neither sufficient alone; the record captures a dual-component structure.

dispositions.label: renamed_to_avoid_prior_objection
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger substitutes 'herd-keeping' for the disputed 'rearing' so the activity will be admitted as care; this is strategic renaming in response to an earlier objection.

dispositions.label: rhetoric_defined_as_psychagogia
dispositions.reason: Socrates directly proposes rhetoric as soul-leading through words across public and private settings, exactly the licensed target's definitional-proposal function.

dispositions.label: rhetorical_competence_conditions
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Natural aptitude, knowledge, and practice are jointly required for complete rhetorical competence, with absence of any one producing a corresponding deficiency.

dispositions.label: right_opinion_introduced
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Larissa example introduces true opinion as a second guide to correct action alongside knowledge, revising a premise about guidance rather than testing a definition.

dispositions.label: scope_delimitation
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The five records set or contest the extension of an inquiry, predicate, subject class, or practice—from all courage cases and false pleasure to precise crafts and rhetoric's domain—so scope control is the shared operation.

dispositions.label: semantic_refinement_defends_definition
dispositions.reason: Critias separates doing, making, and working to insulate 'doing one's own' from the contradiction just raised; the function is defensive near-synonym refinement.

dispositions.label: sequence_of_topics_announced
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The sole record is rejected because it mistakes a funeral-oratory praise sequence for a definition ladder and duplicates accepted procedural coverage; no accepted evidence supports a merge.

dispositions.label: single_name_divided_into_many_kinds
dispositions.reason: The Laws expands the nearly single name 'hunting' into aquatic, avian, land-animal, and multiple human kinds; the repeatable function is one-name diairetic expansion.

dispositions.label: socratic_premise_recalled_by_interlocutor
dispositions.reason: Nicias applies a recalled Socratic premise to propose courage as a kind of wisdom; the attribution and inference remain local while the resulting speech act matches the licensed proposal target.

dispositions.label: sophist_defined_by_genus
dispositions.reason: Shared textual function: The Stranger provisionally classifies the sophist as a sorcerer and imitator and secures assent, performing a definitional proposal even though later division refines it.

dispositions.label: soul_honor_criterion_by_betterment
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Athenian makes improvement from a worse condition the criterion distinguishing genuine soul-honor from ineffective speeches, gifts, or concessions.

dispositions.label: structural_constraint_for_soul_argument
dispositions.reason: The records impose different structural tests on knowledge-of-knowledge, dissolution, harmony's dependence, and scalar harmony versus non-scalar soul; this mixed constraint cluster cannot wholly match either licensed target.

dispositions.label: study_distinguished_from_practical_use
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates contrasts guardians' truth-directed arithmetic with merchants' buying-and-selling use of the same subject, separating philosophical study from practical application.

dispositions.label: successive_binary_division
dispositions.reason: The Stranger performs four assent-confirmed dichotomies from art through acquisition and hunting toward angling; the repeatable function is successive binary diairesis.

dispositions.label: successive_category_enumeration
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates successively submits shapes, colors, sounds, and smells to the intrinsic-beauty and unmixed-pleasure criteria, forming a sensory category sequence.

dispositions.label: successive_domain_enumeration
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger lists five escalating domains in which the sophist claims disputational competence, with Theaetetus confirming each step; this is scope enumeration.

dispositions.label: syllable_as_composite_unit
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates lays out a compositional ladder from elements to syllables, syllables to names and verbs, and those units to speech; the record tracks composition rather than defining syllable.

dispositions.label: synonym_rejected_as_empty_naming
dispositions.reason: Socrates rejects Callicles' synonym for 'better' as mere name substitution before offering 'more intelligent' as a candidate; the two-stage rejection-and-repair function is sharper than proposal alone.

dispositions.label: synonymous_terms_conflated_as_one
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The records explicitly collapse political and kingly terms into one referent and appearance with perception in a qualified domain; terminological identification is the shared operation.

dispositions.label: teleological_cause_method_proposed
dispositions.reason: The five Phaedo records build a method for seeking what is best as true cause, apply it cosmically and personally, and distinguish causes from material conditions; this is a causal method cluster.

dispositions.label: temporal_condition_for_virtue_display
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Lysian speaker postpones proof of the non-lover's character until the beloved's youthful bloom has ceased, making a future temporal condition govern virtue-display.

dispositions.label: temporal_units_defined_by_orbital_periods
dispositions.reason: Timaeus directly defines night-and-day, month, and year by specified celestial periods, so all cited content performs the licensed target's definitional-proposal function.

dispositions.label: temporal_universality_test
dispositions.reason: The candidate for the fine is forced across present, future, and past to test whether it is always fine; this signed anchor is a definition tested by a temporal case range.

dispositions.label: term_assigned_to_distinction
dispositions.reason: Both records coin or assign terms to already drawn distinctions—purification for one separation branch and doxosophia or doxokalia for ignorance species—so taxonomic naming is the common function.

dispositions.label: term_divided_into_two_species
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Athenian divides the sources of victory into boldness toward enemies and fear of shame regarding bad friends; this is a formal binary subdivision.

dispositions.label: thesis_contrast_without_definition
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The sole record is rejected because its positive thesis contrast is already preserved nearby and the label merely says the span is not definitional; no accepted evidence supports a merge.

dispositions.label: thesis_narrowed_under_pressure
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Under Socrates' examples, Theaetetus restricts knowledge-as-perception to the immediately perceptible aspect and excludes what instruction supplies; this is thesis qualification.

dispositions.label: thesis_refuted_by_counter_thesis
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: A reported speaker reverses like-to-like friendship by advancing the opposed needy-pairs thesis with examples; this is counter-thesis substitution rather than a definition case-test.

dispositions.label: third_kind_introduced
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: After unlimited and limit, Socrates introduces and names the mixed as a third kind composed from both; the move adds a taxonomic member before analyzing it.

dispositions.label: threefold_value_partition
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The paired records establish the same tripartition of all things into good, bad, and a neutral intermediate class, with concrete examples used to populate that taxonomy.

dispositions.label: threshold_marker_for_target
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The vestibule metaphor marks that the inquiry has reached the good's threshold without claiming arrival, a progress marker rather than a definition.

dispositions.label: timeliness_reverses_evaluative_predicates
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Stranger makes kairos determine whether opposed tendencies receive praise-names or blame-names, recording context-dependent reversal of evaluative predicates.

dispositions.label: tripartite_classification_introduced
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Both records introduce a three-way framework—wise, ignorant, and intermediate philosophers, or good, bad, and neutral kinds—as a classificatory tool before further inquiry.

dispositions.label: true_and_counterfeit_honors_distinguished
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Athenian charges the lawgiver with separating true bodily honor from counterfeit extremes and identifies the moderate middle as safest; this is evaluative classification.

dispositions.label: truth_as_condition_for_being
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: Socrates makes truth a necessary ingredient for a mixture genuinely to become or be; the passage states an ontological condition without defining truth.

dispositions.label: twinness_shared_name
dispositions.reason: Paired arithmetic and measurement arts are described as twins that nevertheless share one name, marking a structural one-name/two-art feature.

dispositions.label: twofold_classification_introduced
dispositions.reason: Distinct textual function: The Athenian opens a two-kind classification of fear, contrasting expected evils with reputational shame; the cited span introduces rather than completes the taxonomy.
